description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ProviderRedirectTrait' that provides redirect handling functionalities for OAuth2 provider classes, including methods to follow redirects, retrieve HTTP client, and set redirect limits.

methods.name: followRequestRedirects
methods.description: Handles following redirects for a given request, up to a limit, and returns the final response.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the HTTP client instance.

methods.name: getRedirectLimit
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of redirects allowed.

methods.name: isRedirect
methods.description: Determines if a response indicates a redirect based on status code and headers.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Sends a request and handles potential redirect responses, returning the final ResponseInterface.

methods.name: setRedirectLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of redirects; validates input.
